newsitem.title: USA: InPhyNet, MedPartners set merger vote date.
newsitem.headline: InPhyNet, MedPartners set merger vote date.

text.p: InPhyNet Medical Management Inc said Thursday it has set June 26 as the special meeting date for its stockholders to vote on the proposed merger with MedPartners Inc.
Shareholders of record May 12 will be entitled to vote at the meeting, the company said.
The merger was approved by both companies' boards and must be approved by a majority of InPhyNet's stockholders.
The companies entered the merger pact on January 27. Terms call for each share of InPhyNet common stock to be converted at a fixed ratio into 1.18 shares of MedPartners common stock.
